rules.statement: The court has discretion under Section 189 read with Section 839 of the Civil Procedure Code to correct accidental slips or omissions.
rules.supporting_quote: Court has ample power under section 189 read with section 839 of the Civil Procedure Code to correct the error in question as it was an accidental slip or ommission

meta.parties: Sumanadewa and Another v. Sediris and Another
